purpose: Single deployment entry index for the public LicoMesh gateway platform.

openOrder.why: Deployment map, Docker presets, and verification commands.

Authoritative reproducible server source package builder.

Fresh-container deployment proof for LicoMesh, including resumable dependency cache, Docker BuildKit cache mounts, Core compose startup, optional-plugin absence, MCP baseline, destructive rejection, and cleanup.

stopRules: Do not add deployment defaults outside this index without extending server:verify:deployment-index.

withVueConsole.purpose: Build and serve the Vue Console from build/dist.

static.checks: Index shape, referenced paths, Dockerfile defaults, and package script wiring.
Builds and verifies the canonical reproducible server source archive and checksum.

freshContainer.checks: Builds and verifies the canonical server source archive, expands that artifact into an isolated context, runs resumable npm artifact cache verification, builds the Docker image with BuildKit cache mounts, starts docker compose, verifies container health, Core discovery, and MCP baseline operations, proves optional plugin surfaces remain absent without explicit installed artifacts and configuration, rejects malformed/unauthenticated MCP calls, and cleans up containers and fixture state.
